title: Lower bounds for all open VRF instances
text: Imported the prefix–suffix lower bounds of Alejandro-Soto, Segura & Trejo-Sanchez (2026, Computers & Operations Research 191, 107445). Every one of the 218 open VRF instances (43 small, 175 large) now has a lower bound, so all 600 instances show a gap. 204 best-known VRF permutations from the same source were added; they will be re-evaluated automatically once the VRF instance files are hosted. No upper bound or Taillard lower bound changed.

title: Repository launched
text: Initial release with the Taillard (120) and VRF (480) benchmarks. Bounds imported from the Brunner v13 dataset (18 Nov 2026), which extends the Gmys (2021) compilation. All 120 Taillard upper bounds are verified against their permutations.
